CHAPTER TWO
The Weather Door

The doorway opened onto a shore that neither traveler recognized. Sand lifted
in slow spirals, but the wind never touched their faces. On the far side of
the water, a lantern blinked three times: a greeting, or a warning.

"We can go back," Jalen said. "The orchard will still be there."

"Not if the bell is calling the trees away."

Mira placed the marked map on a flat stone. Its ink rearranged itself into a
line of small squares. The first square filled with gold, and a second bell
answered from somewhere under the shore.

The door narrowed. They stepped through together, carrying one compass, two
lamps, and the unanswered question of who had built the orchard.
